questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. When roads are wet, slow down, avoid sudden braking or turning, and increase your distance from the vehicle ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes especially slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the posted speed. Always slow down if road or weather conditions are poor.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are diamond-shaped, yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that a divided highway is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right and then to the left ahead. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you to be careful when the road is wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or along with your vehicle's turn signals. When your left arm is bent at the elbow and points upward, it signals a right turn or right lane change.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. It means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Riders can use hand signals instead of turn signals. A left arm extended straight out means the rider plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always yield to pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk. Stay alert for pedestrians when driving through intersections or turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction are about to combine into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs tell drivers to stop and yield the right-of-way at an intersection. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead. Be careful and watch for pedestrians in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing downward over a lane means you are allowed to use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. The left lane is reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and at least one passenger.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a steep hill is coming. Be ready to adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. A traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. Stay on the right side of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the divided highway is about to end.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign alerts you to an intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic speed and movement. They display rules you must obey. This sign tells you to keep right to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a railroad crossing ahead. Slow down when you approach railroad tracks. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for trains to pass before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs warn you to slow down at intersections and be ready to stop. Yield to other drivers and pedestrians. You may go when it is safe.
